title: WaterSound West "Beach Adventure" West 25 Full Moon Lane
h1: WaterSound West "Beach Adventure" West 25 Full Moon Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 4 adult bikes- Watersound Fitness Access (additional fees apply) - 9-foot ceilings, hardwood floors- Enjoy the use of complimentary backpack beach chairs(2 chairs 1 umbrella) provided with your home for the 2026 year.- Free WiFi- Gourmet Kitchen with gas range- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutLOCATION: This home is a 4-minute bike ride to the beach.DETAILS: Stunning location meets coastal elegance! This spacious 4-bedroom coastal retreat sleeps 10 and offers an additional living/sleeping area. The master bedroom includes a private bathroom with a double vanity and a spacious stand-up shower. There is an extra master bedroom upstairs with a private bathroom. You will also find the two guest bedrooms on this floor, one with a queen bed and one with a full. This beach cottage has 9-foot ceilings, hardwood floors, a custom gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, and stainless appliances, including a 5-burner gas range with a warming drawer, microwave, dishwasher, and a French door refrigerator. A washer/dryer room and powder room are located off the hallway from the living area. All the bathrooms showcase granite counters. Six flat screened TVs are featured throughout the home; in the living room, upstairs den, and each bedroom.The living area is decorated in beach blues and sandy neutrals with lots of room to spread out and enjoy a surround sound stereo plus a separate bar area. The dining room seats eight comfortably, and four barstools at the kitchen counter. If you enjoy outside dining, the screened porch supports a dining table that seats eight. If relaxing is your main concentration, there is a sitting area on the screened porch with a sofa and rocking chair. The home also comes equipped with WIFI, a two-car driveway for parking, and an outdoor shower. The beach is a delightful 10 minutes walk away. Check with our Concierge department to rent additional bikes and beach gear to make the ride or walk much easier!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10)FIRST FLOOR: -Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom SECOND FLOOR: -Master Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom-Guest Bedroom: Full Bed, Shared Bathroom-Additional Living/Sleeping Space: Two Twin BedsWATERSOUND WEST BEACH HIGHLIGHTS- Secluded 256-acre gated community in the heart of 30A- Premiere natural setting to experience local flora and fauna- Beautiful walkover paths among towering dunes - the best on the Emerald Coast- Situated equidistant between Rosemary Beach and Seaside- Gorgeous zero-entry neighborhood pool featuring cabanas- Outdoor grill and fireplace for gatherings with loved ones- Horseshoe Park and Puttering Park - Direct access to the beach (no streets to cross or stairs to climb)- Access to WaterSound Beach Fitness Center*Due to safety concerns, the Watersound HOA does not allow bicycles on the West Beach Boardwalk. A bike-friendly path has been added to the left of the clubhouse, which will lead you to the Watersound West Beach access. Please be aware of pedestrians on the walkway.*Unfortunately, the HOA does not allow guests to rent Low-Speed Vehicles.
